purpose: Execute the atomic sweep-profile-along-path operation within the MA-09 boundary: One transient SweepProfile action with a caller-supplied ordered path. No profile creation, attachment, Boolean, or persistence is included.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires sweep-profile-along-path and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Nonempty ordered path collection; connectivity and suitability are delegated to the kernel/caller contract.

preconditions: The profile is closed and the path is ordered, connected, and suitable for a solid sweep.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: A transient closed nonempty swept body.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper; runtime execution is evidenced by the attached exact candidate host record; native persistence, visual review, and requested export remain outside this action.
implementation.notes: Execute the atomic sweep-profile-along-path operation within the MA-09 boundary: One transient SweepProfile action with a caller-supplied ordered path. No profile creation, attachment, Boolean, or persistence is included. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.

ambiguity_checks: No document selection is performed inside this action; supplied references are validated directly.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable for the transient result.

failure_modes.condition: An empty path raises ValueError before the API call.
failure_modes.detection: An empty path raises ValueError before the API call.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use until the declared recovery is completed from a clean state.

failure_modes.condition: SweepProfile raises or the result fails assert_closed.
failure_modes.detection: SweepProfile raises or the result fails assert_closed.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use and retain only a clean run-owned state.

recovery.action: Discard the transient result, repair profile/path connectivity, and rerun.

validation.method: Validate the emitted object against operation-template.schema.json and the catalog operation ID.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, candidate-only, and uses the catalog slug under the modeling_strategy_scripting stage.

validation.method: Parse the linked action source and compare SHA-256 bindings for the available action artifacts.
validation.expected: The linked source is a single bounded operation function and no absolute path is emitted.

validation.method: Inspect the evidence_level layer records before promotion.
validation.expected: Only the exact attached host, SpaceClaim execution, and geometry-measurement evidence layers are marked passed; native save/reopen, visual review, and requested export remain not tested or not applicable.

validation.check: Declared postcondition: The returned body passes assert_closed.
validation.method: Execute the exact linked action in an isolated authorized SpaceClaim V21 session and inspect the action-specific result contract.

evidence_level.notes: Exact action source/archive hashes match the historical run event and selected passing groups. The portable harness body is byte-identical after removing machine-specific configuration; it is not the full executed source. snapshot-map.json records the original configured source/archive hashes. No persistence, export or full visual claim.
